2609.19315.title: GAVEL: Graph World Models for Verified and Efficient Long-Horizon LLM Task Planning
2609.19315.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability. We present GAVEL, a framework for verifying and repairing long-horizon LLM planning built around an explicit graph world model. The graph represents relevant object-relations, action pre-conditions and effects, and probabilistic beliefs over unobserved object locations. This model can predict the consequences of LLM-generated actions before execution, detect violations, and repair those whose corrections follow directly from the world model. This method also reserves LLM replanning solely for errors requiring semantic reasoning. For multi-task instructions, GAVEL reasons over distributions of possible object locations to reorder remaining subtasks and minimize expected search cost. We evaluate GAVEL on BEHAVIOR-1K across 100 single long-horizon tasks and 500 multi-task instructions. With Qwen3-8B, GAVEL improves single-task success from 41.2% to 91.8% and multi-task success from 19.9% to 92.6%. Distributional belief reasoning also reduces travel distance by approximately 5.4% compared with a static variant. These improvements show that an explicit graph world model harness can substantially improve the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon embodied planning across compact and frontier hosted LLM capabilities.
2609.19315.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）為長期機器人規劃提供了一個靈活的介面，但生成的計劃往往無法遵守具身約束、從規劃錯誤中恢復或在部分可觀察性下有效推理。<lb/>我們提出了 GAVEL，一個基於明確圖形世界模型的長期 LLM 規劃驗證和修復框架。<lb/>該圖形表示相關的物體關係、行動前提和效果，以及對未觀察物體位置的概率信念。<lb/>這個模型可以在執行之前預測 LLM 生成的行動的後果，檢測違規情況，並修復那些其修正直接來自世界模型的情況。<lb/>這種方法還將 LLM 重新規劃專門保留給需要語義推理的錯誤。<lb/>對於多任務指令，GAVEL 在可能的物體位置的分佈上進行推理，以重新排序剩餘的子任務並最小化預期搜索成本。<lb/>我們在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上評估 GAVEL，涵蓋 100 個單一長期任務和 500 個多任務指令。<lb/>使用 Qwen3-8B，GAVEL 將單任務成功率從 41.2% 提高到 91.8%，將多任務成功率從 19.9% 提高到 92.6%。<lb/>分佈信念推理還將旅行距離與靜態變體相比減少了約 5.4%。<lb/>這些改進顯示，明確的圖形世界模型框架可以顯著提高長期具身規劃在緊湊和前沿托管 LLM 能力下的可靠性和效率。
